item.title: Bulletin updated at 16:30 HKT 21/Sep/2023
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
A weak northeast monsoon will reach the coast of Guangdong tomorrow. It will be cloudier with a few showers over the region in the next couple of days. Under the influence of the anticyclone aloft, the weather will be generally fine over the coast of Guangdong early next week. Besides, a broad trough of low pressure will bring unsettled weather to the vicinity of the central part of the South China Sea and the Philippines next week. Another surge of the northeast monsoon is expected to reach southern China in the latter part of next week. There will be a few showers over the region.
